entities.name: Crovax's Coronation
entities.description: The formal installation of Crovax as the seventh Evincar of Rath in 4205 AR, consolidating Phyrexian power.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A former Weatherlight crew member turned Phyrexian life force vampire who becomes the seventh Evincar of Rath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The former Evincar of Rath, who departs for Mercadia, returns to challenge Crovax, and is executed.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A young wizard and candidate to succeed Volrath who comes to believe resistance to Crovax is futile and is compleated.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A Predator captain who emerged as a candidate to replace Volrath.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: The Phyrexian emissary who formally recognizes Crovax as Evincar under duress.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: An elven leader proclaimed the Korvecdal and uniter of the Rathi tribes, who escapes Rath through a portal.

entities.name: Takara en-Dal
entities.description: A rebel who escapes Rath with Eladamri.

entities.name: Sivvi en-Vec
entities.description: A rebel who escapes Rath with Eladamri.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane where the coronation takes place.

entities.name: The Stronghold
entities.description: The seat of power on Rath where the coronation occurs.

entities.name: Phyrexian Inner Circle
entities.description: Phyrexian leadership that orchestrated the power struggle to choose Volrath's successor.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The airship whose crew Crovax once belonged to.

events.summary: After Volrath's mysterious departure for Mercadia, several candidates, including Ertai and Greven il-Vec, emerge as potential replacements, but Crovax shows the will to dominate the contest.
events.quote: Following Volrath's mysterious departure for Mercadia

events.summary: Phyrexian modification grants Crovax flowstone control and enhanced abilities, letting him overpower rivals.
events.quote: Crovax was granted access to flowstone control and enhanced physical abilities by Phyrexian modification

events.summary: Crovax brutally suppresses dissent, including the mass execution of tribal hostages.
events.quote: his brutal suppression of dissent, including the mass execution of Vec , Dal , and Kor tribal hostages

events.summary: Volrath returns to Rath and challenges Crovax for the throne but is defeated, undermined in part by Ertai.
Belbe formally recognizes Crovax as Evincar under considerable duress.
events.quote: Crovax was formally recognized as Evincar by Belbe

events.summary: Ertai allows himself to be compleated, turning to Phyrexia, and Volrath is gruesomely executed.
Eladamri, Takara en-Dal and Sivvi en-Vec escape Rath through a planar portal.
events.quote: escaped the plane and Crovax's bloodthirst through a planar portal

relations.note: Crovax becomes the seventh Evincar of Rath.
relations.quote: the formal installation of Crovax as the seventh Evincar of Rath

relations.note: Volrath challenged Crovax for the throne and lost.
relations.quote: the former Evincar challenged Crovax for the throne

relations.note: Fellow rebel who escaped with Eladamri.
relations.quote: joined by fellow rebels Takara en-Dal and Sivvi en-Vec
